choices.label: Share the vision with all followers
choices.description: Proclaim the vision as a sign of divine favor.

choices.label: Keep it as a sacred secret

choices.description: Save the extra food for lean times.

choices.description: Channel the energy into spiritual commitment.

choices.description: Turn the complaint into a recruitment opportunity.

choices.label: Ignore the complaint

choices.description: Spend resources to purify the compound.

choices.label: Do nothing and hope it passes

choices.description: Purchase exotic supplies for your compound.

choices.label: Trade for knowledge

choices.label: Rob the merchant

choices.label: Feed them false information
choices.description: Send the scout back with misleading intelligence.

choices.label: Declare it a true prophecy
choices.description: Elevate the follower and spread the message.

choices.label: Dismiss it as just a dream

choices.label: Sell it to a collector

choices.description: Throw your support behind a sympathetic politician.

choices.label: Remain neutral and negotiate privately
choices.description: Play both sides for maximum benefit.

choices.label: Discourage followers from voting

choices.label: Stall and hide evidence
